package main

import (
	"errors"
	"image/color"
	"math"
	"math/rand"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2"
	"github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/audio"
	"github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/inpututil"
	"github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/text/v2"
	"github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/vector"
	"gameforge.local/sandbox/jpfont"
)

const (
	screenW  = 320
	screenH  = 240
	tileSize = 16
)

const (
	stateTitle = iota
	statePlaying
	stateOver
	stateClear
)

const (
	cols = screenW / tileSize // 20
	rows = screenH / tileSize // 15
)

const (
	tileFloor = 0
	tileWall  = 1
	tileDoor  = 2
)

var roomMaps [3][rows][cols]int

var roomSpiderCount = [3]int{2, 3, 4}

// key positions per room (col, row)
var keyPos = [3][2]int{{5, 5}, {4, 7}, {9, 11}}

// door positions
// Room0: col10 row5 — horizontal wall gap, only path from key area to exit side
// Room1: col14 row7 — vertical wall gap, only path to right side where exit is
// Room2: col9 row13 (unchanged)
var doorPos = [3][2]int{{10, 5}, {14, 7}, {9, 13}}

// exit positions
// Room0: col17 row7 (right area, reachable only after passing door)
// Room1: col18 row7 (right edge area, reachable only after passing door)
// Room2: col10 row14 (bottom edge, unchanged)
var exitPos = [3][2]int{{17, 7}, {18, 7}, {10, 14}}

var artPalette = map[byte]color.RGBA{
	'1': {0x88, 0x55, 0x22, 0xff},
	'2': {0xcc, 0x99, 0x44, 0xff},
	'3': {0xff, 0xee, 0xcc, 0xff},
	'4': {0x44, 0x22, 0x00, 0xff},
	'5': {0xaa, 0x77, 0x33, 0xff},
	'6': {0x88, 0x88, 0x88, 0xff},
	'7': {0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xff},
	'8': {0x44, 0x44, 0x44, 0xff},
	'9': {0xff, 0xff, 0x00, 0xff},
	'a': {0xff, 0xaa, 0x00, 0xff},
	'b': {0x33, 0x33, 0x33, 0xff},
}

var mouseArt = []string{
	"..111...",
	".11511.",
	"1133311",
	"1155511",
	".11111.",
	"..121..",
}

var spiderArt = []string{
	"8.6668.8",
	"88.66.88",
	".866668.",
	".8b66b8.",
	"8.6668.8",
	"8..66..8",
}

var keyArt = []string{
	".999.",
	"9aaa9",
	".999.",
	"..9..",
	".999.",
	"..9..",
}

func newSprite(art []string) *ebiten.Image {
	if len(art) == 0 {
		return ebiten.NewImage(1, 1)
	}
	w := len(art[0])
	h := len(art)
	img := ebiten.NewImage(w, h)
	for y, row := range art {
		for x := 0; x < len(row); x++ {
			if clr, ok := artPalette[row[x]]; ok {
				img.Set(x, y, clr)
			}
		}
	}
	return img
}

type Spider struct {
	x, y   float64
	vx, vy float64
	alive  bool
}

type Game struct {
	state     int
	face      text.Face
	mouseImg  *ebiten.Image
	spiderImg *ebiten.Image
	keyImg    *ebiten.Image

	room        int
	px, py      float64
	hasKey      bool
	keyPickedUp bool
	spiders     []Spider
	score       int
	tick        int

	audioCtx  *audio.Context
	sfxKey    []byte
	sfxDmg    []byte
	sfxClear  []byte
	hp        int
	invFrames int
}

func squareWave(freq, vol float64, samples int) []byte {
	pcm := make([]byte, samples*8)
	step := freq / float64(48000)
	phase := 0.0
	for i := 0; i < len(pcm); i += 8 {
		level := float32(vol)
		if math.Mod(phase, 1) >= 0.5 {
			level = -level
		}
		bits := math.Float32bits(level)
		pcm[i] = byte(bits)
		pcm[i+1] = byte(bits >> 8)
		pcm[i+2] = byte(bits >> 16)
		pcm[i+3] = byte(bits >> 24)
		pcm[i+4] = pcm[i]
		pcm[i+5] = pcm[i+1]
		pcm[i+6] = pcm[i+2]
		pcm[i+7] = pcm[i+3]
		phase += step
	}
	return pcm
}

func sineWave(freq, vol float64, samples int) []byte {
	pcm := make([]byte, samples*8)
	step := freq / float64(48000)
	phase := 0.0
	for i := 0; i < len(pcm); i += 8 {
		level := float32(math.Sin(phase*2*math.Pi) * vol)
		bits := math.Float32bits(level)
		pcm[i] = byte(bits)
		pcm[i+1] = byte(bits >> 8)
		pcm[i+2] = byte(bits >> 16)
		pcm[i+3] = byte(bits >> 24)
		pcm[i+4] = pcm[i]
		pcm[i+5] = pcm[i+1]
		pcm[i+6] = pcm[i+2]
		pcm[i+7] = pcm[i+3]
		phase += step
	}
	return pcm
}

func setW(m *[rows][cols]int, x, y int) {
	if y >= 0 && y < rows && x >= 0 && x < cols {
		m[y][x] = tileWall
	}
}

func buildMaps() {
	// ---- Room 0 ----
	// Layout:
	//   Player starts at col2,row2.
	//   Key at col5,row5 (left area).
	//   A horizontal wall runs along row5 from col0 to col19 (border to border),
	//   with door at col10,row5 as the ONLY gap.
	//   Left area (cols 1-9, rows 1-4 and rows 6-13): player roams, finds key.
	//   Right area (cols 11-18, rows 6-13): exit at col17,row7.
	//   Without key, door is solid -> player cannot reach exit.
	var r0 [rows][cols]int
	// border walls
	for y := 0; y < rows; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
			if y == 0 || y == rows-1 || x == 0 || x == cols-1 {
				r0[y][x] = tileWall
			}
		}
	}
	// horizontal dividing wall at row5, col1..col19 except col10 (door)
	for x := 1; x < cols-1; x++ {
		if x != doorPos[0][0] {
			r0[5][x] = tileWall
		}
	}
	// door at col10,row5
	r0[doorPos[0][1]][doorPos[0][0]] = tileDoor
	// exit at col17,row7 (floor, already floor by default)
	r0[exitPos[0][1]][exitPos[0][0]] = tileFloor
	// some internal walls in left area to add interest
	for y := 1; y <= 4; y++ {
		setW(&r0, 7, y)
	}
	for y := 7; y <= 13; y++ {
		setW(&r0, 4, y)
	}
	// some internal walls in right area
	for y := 6; y <= 10; y++ {
		setW(&r0, 14, y)
	}
	for x := 11; x <= 15; x++ {
		setW(&r0, x, 11)
	}
	roomMaps[0] = r0

	// ---- Room 1 ----
	// Layout:
	//   Player starts at col2,row2.
	//   Key at col4,row7 (left area).
	//   A vertical wall runs along col14 from row1 to row13,
	//   with door at col14,row7 as the ONLY gap.
	//   Left area (cols 1-13): player roams, finds key.
	//   Right area (cols 15-18): exit at col18,row7.
	//   Without key, door is solid -> player cannot reach exit.
	var r1 [rows][cols]int
	for y := 0; y < rows; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
			if y == 0 || y == rows-1 || x == 0 || x == cols-1 {
				r1[y][x] = tileWall
			}
		}
	}
	// vertical dividing wall at col14, row1..row13 except row7 (door)
	for y := 1; y < rows-1; y++ {
		if y != doorPos[1][1] {
			r1[y][14] = tileWall
		}
	}
	// door at col14,row7
	r1[doorPos[1][1]][doorPos[1][0]] = tileDoor
	// exit at col18,row7 (floor)
	r1[exitPos[1][1]][exitPos[1][0]] = tileFloor
	// internal walls in left area
	for y := 1; y <= 5; y++ {
		setW(&r1, 7, y)
	}
	for y := 9; y <= 13; y++ {
		setW(&r1, 7, y)
	}
	for x := 2; x <= 6; x++ {
		setW(&r1, x, 11)
	}
	for x := 8; x <= 12; x++ {
		setW(&r1, x, 4)
	}
	// internal walls in right area (small maze)
	setW(&r1, 16, 5)
	setW(&r1, 16, 6)
	setW(&r1, 16, 8)
	setW(&r1, 16, 9)
	roomMaps[1] = r1

	// ---- Room 2 (unchanged) ----
	var r2 [rows][cols]int
	for y := 0; y < rows; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
			if y == 0 || y == rows-1 || x == 0 || x == cols-1 {
				r2[y][x] = tileWall
			}
		}
	}
	walls2 := [][2]int{
		{4, 1}, {4, 2}, {4, 3}, {4, 4},
		{4, 6}, {4, 7}, {4, 8}, {4, 9}, {4, 10},
		{9, 4}, {9, 5}, {9, 6}, {9, 7}, {9, 8},
		{14, 2}, {14, 3}, {14, 4}, {14, 5},
		{14, 9}, {14, 10}, {14, 11}, {14, 12},
		{7, 11}, {8, 11}, {10, 11}, {11, 11},
		{7, 12}, {7, 13},
		{12, 12}, {12, 13},
		{8, 12}, {10, 12}, {11, 12},
		{8, 13}, {11, 13},
	}
	for _, w := range walls2 {
		setW(&r2, w[0], w[1])
	}
	r2[doorPos[2][1]][doorPos[2][0]] = tileDoor
	r2[exitPos[2][1]][exitPos[2][0]] = tileFloor
	roomMaps[2] = r2
}

func (g *Game) initRoom(room int) {
	g.room = room
	g.hasKey = false
	g.keyPickedUp = false
	roomMaps[room][doorPos[room][1]][doorPos[room][0]] = tileDoor

	count := roomSpiderCount[room]
	g.spiders = make([]Spider, count)
	for i := range g.spiders {
		for {
			tx := rand.Intn(cols-2) + 1
			ty := rand.Intn(rows-2) + 1
			if roomMaps[room][ty][tx] == tileFloor {
				g.spiders[i] = Spider{
					x:     float64(tx*tileSize + tileSize/2),
					y:     float64(ty*tileSize + tileSize/2),
					vx:    (rand.Float64()*1.5 + 0.5) * float64([]int{-1, 1}[rand.Intn(2)]),
					vy:    (rand.Float64()*1.5 + 0.5) * float64([]int{-1, 1}[rand.Intn(2)]),
					alive: true,
				}
				break
			}
		}
	}
}

func (g *Game) reset() {
	g.px = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.py = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.hp = 5
	g.score = 0
	g.tick = 0
	g.invFrames = 0
	buildMaps()
	g.initRoom(0)
}

func tileAt(room, tx, ty int) int {
	if tx < 0 || tx >= cols || ty < 0 || ty >= rows {
		return tileWall
	}
	return roomMaps[room][ty][tx]
}

func isSolidR(room int, x, y, r float64) bool {
	for _, dx := range []float64{-r, r} {
		for _, dy := range []float64{-r, r} {
			tx := int(math.Floor((x + dx) / tileSize))
			ty := int(math.Floor((y + dy) / tileSize))
			t := tileAt(room, tx, ty)
			if t == tileWall || t == tileDoor {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isSolid(room int, x, y float64) bool {
	return isSolidR(room, x, y, 6.0)
}

func (g *Game) Update() error {
	g.tick++
	switch g.state {
	case stateTitle:
		if inpututil.IsKeyJustPressed(ebiten.KeySpace) {
			g.reset()
			g.state = statePlaying
		}
	case statePlaying:
		speed := 2.0
		nx, ny := g.px, g.py
		if ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyLeft) || ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyA) {
			nx -= speed
		}
		if ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyRight) || ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyD) {
			nx += speed
		}
		if ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyUp) || ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyW) {
			ny -= speed
		}
		if ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyDown) || ebiten.IsKeyPressed(ebiten.KeyS) {
			ny += speed
		}
		if !isSolid(g.room, nx, g.py) {
			g.px = nx
		}
		if !isSolid(g.room, g.px, ny) {
			g.py = ny
		}

		// key pickup
		if !g.keyPickedUp {
			kx := float64(keyPos[g.room][0]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
			ky := float64(keyPos[g.room][1]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
			dx := g.px - kx
			dy := g.py - ky
			if dx*dx+dy*dy < 12*12 {
				g.keyPickedUp = true
				g.hasKey = true
				g.score += 100
				roomMaps[g.room][doorPos[g.room][1]][doorPos[g.room][0]] = tileFloor
				if g.audioCtx.IsReady() {
					p := g.audioCtx.NewPlayerF32FromBytes(g.sfxKey)
					p.Play()
				}
			}
		}

		// exit check
		ex := float64(exitPos[g.room][0]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
		ey := float64(exitPos[g.room][1]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
		dx := g.px - ex
		dy := g.py - ey
		if dx*dx+dy*dy < 10*10 && g.hasKey {
			if g.room < 2 {
				g.score += 200
				next := g.room + 1
				g.px = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
				g.py = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
				g.initRoom(next)
			} else {
				g.score += 500
				if g.audioCtx.IsReady() {
					p := g.audioCtx.NewPlayerF32FromBytes(g.sfxClear)
					p.Play()
				}
				g.state = stateClear
			}
		}

		// spiders
		for i := range g.spiders {
			s := &g.spiders[i]
			if !s.alive {
				continue
			}
			cdx := g.px - s.x
			cdy := g.py - s.y
			dist := math.Sqrt(cdx*cdx + cdy*cdy)
			if dist > 0 {
				chase := 0.4
				s.vx = s.vx*0.95 + (cdx/dist)*chase
				s.vy = s.vy*0.95 + (cdy/dist)*chase
			}
			spd := math.Sqrt(s.vx*s.vx + s.vy*s.vy)
			maxSpd := 1.5
			if spd > maxSpd {
				s.vx = s.vx / spd * maxSpd
				s.vy = s.vy / spd * maxSpd
			}
			snx := s.x + s.vx
			sny := s.y + s.vy
			sr := 6.0
			if !isSolidR(g.room, snx, s.y, sr) {
				s.x = snx
			} else {
				s.vx = -s.vx
			}
			if !isSolidR(g.room, s.x, sny, sr) {
				s.y = sny
			} else {
				s.vy = -s.vy
			}

			if g.invFrames == 0 {
				sdx := g.px - s.x
				sdy := g.py - s.y
				if sdx*sdx+sdy*sdy < 13*13 {
					g.hp--
					g.invFrames = 60
					if g.audioCtx.IsReady() {
						p := g.audioCtx.NewPlayerF32FromBytes(g.sfxDmg)
						p.Play()
					}
					if g.hp <= 0 {
						g.state = stateOver
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if g.invFrames > 0 {
			g.invFrames--
		}
	case stateOver:
		if inpututil.IsKeyJustPressed(ebiten.KeySpace) {
			g.reset()
			g.state = statePlaying
		}
	case stateClear:
		if inpututil.IsKeyJustPressed(ebiten.KeySpace) {
			g.reset()
			g.state = statePlaying
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var floorColor = color.RGBA{0x33, 0x22, 0x11, 0xff}
var wallColor = color.RGBA{0x77, 0x77, 0x77, 0xff}
var doorClosedColor = color.RGBA{0x66, 0x44, 0x00, 0xff}

func drawRoom(screen *ebiten.Image, room int) {
	for y := 0; y < rows; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
			t := roomMaps[room][y][x]
			var clr color.RGBA
			switch t {
			case tileFloor:
				clr = floorColor
			case tileWall:
				clr = wallColor
			case tileDoor:
				clr = doorClosedColor
			}
			fx := float32(x * tileSize)
			fy := float32(y * tileSize)
			vector.DrawFilledRect(screen, fx, fy, float32(tileSize), float32(tileSize), clr, false)
		}
	}
}

func (g *Game) drawSprites(screen *ebiten.Image) {
	room := g.room
	ex := float32(exitPos[room][0]*tileSize) + 1
	ey := float32(exitPos[room][1]*tileSize) + 1
	exitClr := color.RGBA{0x00, 0xff, 0x88, 0xff}
	if !g.hasKey {
		exitClr = color.RGBA{0x00, 0x88, 0x44, 0xff}
	}
	vector.DrawFilledRect(screen, ex, ey, float32(tileSize-2), float32(tileSize-2), exitClr, false)

	if !g.keyPickedUp {
		kop := &ebiten.DrawImageOptions{}
		kx := float64(keyPos[room][0]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
		ky := float64(keyPos[room][1]*tileSize + tileSize/2)
		kop.GeoM.Translate(-2.5, -3)
		kop.GeoM.Scale(2, 2)
		kop.GeoM.Translate(kx, ky)
		screen.DrawImage(g.keyImg, kop)
	}

	for _, s := range g.spiders {
		if !s.alive {
			continue
		}
		sop := &ebiten.DrawImageOptions{}
		sop.GeoM.Translate(-4, -3)
		sop.GeoM.Scale(2, 2)
		sop.GeoM.Translate(s.x, s.y)
		screen.DrawImage(g.spiderImg, sop)
	}

	if g.state == statePlaying || g.state == stateOver || g.state == stateClear {
		if g.invFrames == 0 || (g.tick/4)%2 == 0 {
			pop := &ebiten.DrawImageOptions{}
			pop.GeoM.Translate(-4, -3)
			pop.GeoM.Scale(2, 2)
			pop.GeoM.Translate(g.px, g.py)
			screen.DrawImage(g.mouseImg, pop)
		}
	}
}

func (g *Game) Draw(screen *ebiten.Image) {
	switch g.state {
	case stateTitle:
		drawRoom(screen, 0)
		g.drawSprites(screen)
		vector.DrawFilledRect(screen, 0, 0, screenW, screenH, color.RGBA{0, 0, 0, 160}, false)
		op := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op.GeoM.Translate(60, 60)
		op.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.RGBA{0xff, 0xff, 0x44, 0xff})
		text.Draw(screen, "ネズミのカギ", g.face, op)
		op2 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op2.GeoM.Translate(20, 100)
		op2.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "カギをとって とびらをひらけ！", g.face, op2)
		op3 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op3.GeoM.Translate(20, 120)
		op3.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "WASDか やじるし：いどう", g.face, op3)
		op4 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op4.GeoM.Translate(20, 140)
		op4.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "3へやをクリアしたら おわり", g.face, op4)
		op5 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op5.GeoM.Translate(60, 180)
		op5.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "スペースキーで スタート", g.face, op5)

	case statePlaying:
		drawRoom(screen, g.room)
		g.drawSprites(screen)
		op := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op.GeoM.Translate(4, 2)
		op.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "HP:"+strconv.Itoa(g.hp)+"  スコア:"+strconv.Itoa(g.score)+"  へや:"+strconv.Itoa(g.room+1)+"/3", g.face, op)
		if g.hasKey {
			op2 := &text.DrawOptions{}
			op2.GeoM.Translate(260, 2)
			op2.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.RGBA{0xff, 0xff, 0x00, 0xff})
			text.Draw(screen, "カギ：あり", g.face, op2)
		}

	case stateOver:
		drawRoom(screen, g.room)
		g.drawSprites(screen)
		vector.DrawFilledRect(screen, 0, 0, screenW, screenH, color.RGBA{0, 0, 0, 160}, false)
		op := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op.GeoM.Translate(100, 80)
		op.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.RGBA{0xff, 0x44, 0x44, 0xff})
		text.Draw(screen, "ゲームオーバー", g.face, op)
		op2 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op2.GeoM.Translate(60, 120)
		op2.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "スコア："+strconv.Itoa(g.score), g.face, op2)
		op3 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op3.GeoM.Translate(50, 160)
		op3.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "スペースキーで もういちど", g.face, op3)

	case stateClear:
		drawRoom(screen, g.room)
		g.drawSprites(screen)
		vector.DrawFilledRect(screen, 0, 0, screenW, screenH, color.RGBA{0, 0, 0, 160}, false)
		op := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op.GeoM.Translate(80, 80)
		op.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.RGBA{0xff, 0xff, 0x44, 0xff})
		text.Draw(screen, "クリア！ おめでとう！", g.face, op)
		op2 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op2.GeoM.Translate(60, 120)
		op2.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "スコア："+strconv.Itoa(g.score), g.face, op2)
		op3 := &text.DrawOptions{}
		op3.GeoM.Translate(50, 160)
		op3.ColorScale.ScaleWithColor(color.White)
		text.Draw(screen, "スペースキーで もういちど", g.face, op3)
	}
}

func (g *Game) Layout(outsideWidth, outsideHeight int) (int, int) {
	return screenW, screenH
}

func main() {
	buildMaps()
	g := &Game{state: stateTitle}
	g.face = text.NewGoXFace(jpfont.Face16)
	g.mouseImg = newSprite(mouseArt)
	g.spiderImg = newSprite(spiderArt)
	g.keyImg = newSprite(keyArt)

	g.audioCtx = audio.NewContext(48000)
	g.sfxKey = sineWave(880, 0.3, 48000/5)
	g.sfxDmg = squareWave(220, 0.3, 48000/8)
	c1 := sineWave(660, 0.25, 48000/3)
	c2 := sineWave(880, 0.25, 48000/3)
	g.sfxClear = make([]byte, len(c1))
	for i := 0; i < len(c1); i++ {
		g.sfxClear[i] = c1[i] + c2[i]
	}

	g.px = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.py = float64(2*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.hp = 5

	ebiten.SetWindowSize(640, 480)
	ebiten.SetWindowTitle("ネズミのカギ")
	if err := ebiten.RunGame(g); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ebiten.Termination) {
		panic(err)
	}
}
